item.title: Stock markets trade lower in early deals on foreign fund outflows, weak global trends
item.description: MUMBAI: Equity benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty declined in early trade on Monday in-tandem with a weak trend in global markets and persistent foreign fund outflows. Also, uncertainty over an India-US trade deal weighed on investors’ sentiment, analysts said. The 30-share BSE Sensex declined 384.39 points to 84,883.27 in early trade. The 50-share NSE Nifty [...]

item.title: Delhi Police on high alert ahead of Lionel Messi’s Delhi visit
item.description: NEW DELHI: Delhi Police has beefed up security in the central parts of the national capital and set up traffic restrictions as global football icon Lionel Messi sets foot in the city, the final stop of his GOAT tour of India. item.description: NEW DELHI: The Airports Authority of India (AAI) on Monday issued a travel advisory as dense fog gripped Northern India, urging passengers to check their flight status before leaving for the airport to avoid prolonged waiting periods at the airport in case of flight cancellations or delays. item.title: Times Now’s Amit Bharrdwaj Wins ENBA Award for Best Field Videography
item.description: JAMMU: Amit Bharrdwaj, Senior Video Journalist with Times Now, has been conferred the prestigious ENBA Award for Best Field Videography in the All India category at a ceremony held in Delhi. Bharrdwaj received the national honour for his compelling and courageous coverage of the Bhillawar attack, in which Pakistani terrorists ambushed an Indian Army vehicle, [...]

item.title: Ex-bureaucrat Raj Kumar Goyal sworn in as Chief Information Commissioner
item.description: NEW DELHI: Former IAS officer Raj Kumar Goyal was on Monday sworn in as Chief Information Commissioner (CIC) by President Droupadi Murmu. A three-member panel headed by Prime Minister Narendra Modi last week recommended Goyal’s name as the CIC. Goyal is a 1990-batch (retired) Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer of Arunachal Pradesh-Goa-Mizoram-Union Territories (AGMUT) cadre. [...]
